acceptance_criteria.description: Runtime config exposes cdxgen enabled and binary path fields with documented YAML and environment-variable names.
Production app construction wires NewCdxgenGenerator into the SBOM generator registry only when cdxgen is enabled.
When cdxgen is disabled, Syft remains the default fallback and explicit generator=cdxgen fails clearly instead of silently falling back.
When cdxgen is enabled but the configured binary is unavailable, explicit generator=cdxgen fails with a clear unavailable-binary error containing the configured path.
Auto selection chooses available cdxgen for repository CycloneDX generation and falls back to Syft when cdxgen is disabled or unavailable.
